children: Chile’s state-run copper ​producer Codelco said on ‌Wednesday it has signed ​a agreement with ⁠India’s Adani Group to develop the Kaburkaala copper exploration ‌project in Chile’s northern region of ‌Antofagasta.
Adani would provide ‌financing ⁠for the project, ⁠which could offer long-term supply for its smelting complex in ​Mundra, India, Codelco ‌said in a statement.
The two companies agreed last year to ‌a partnership and evaluated ​a number of potential Codelco copper ⁠projects before Adani selected Kaburkaala for exploration.
India relies ‌on copper imports to address shortfalls and meet the robust demand in the world’s fastest-growing major economy and ‌has been seeking to ​shore up its supply with investments overseas.
The ⁠agreement was signed between ⁠Codelco and Kutch Copper Limited, part of ‌Adani Group.

title: Adani to finance Chile copper project to secure long-term supply for Mundra smelter
